data.name: Adon
data.gender_notes: Adon is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Adon is a title for God, indicating ownership, lordship, or mastery. It is derived from the Hebrew word adonai, meaning 'my lord'. In the Bible, Adon is used to refer to God and to various earthly lords and masters. The name Adon carries the meaning “Lord, Master” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Adon usually hope their child will grow to embody lord, master and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of divine ownership, mastery, and lordship.
data.etymology: Adon belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord, Master.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Adon total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: אדון
in_hebrew.meaning: אדון הוא שם שפירושו אדון, שליט, או ריבון בעברית
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אדון הוא שם עברי שפירושו אדון, שליט, או ריבון. הוא מופיע בתנ"ך ככינוי לאלוהים, ביטוי את מעמדו כריבון העולם ומחולל ההיסטוריה. השם אדון נגזר מהשורש אדן, שפירושו היה שליטה, חזקה, או תמיכה. השימוש בשם זה מדגיש את היחס בין האל לאדם, כאדון ומשרתו.

in_greek.name: Ἀδών
in_greek.meaning: Ἀδών σημαίνει Κύριος ἤ Δεσπότης ἐν τῇ ἑλληνικῇ γλώττῃ
in_greek.long_meaning: Ἀδών ἐστιν ὄνομα ἑλληνικόν, τὸ ὁποῖον σημαίνει Κύριος ἤ Δεσπότης. Ἐν τῷ Χριστιανισμῷ, τὸ ὄνομα τοῦτο ἐκφράζει τὴν ἐξουσίαν καὶ τὴν κυριαρχίαν τοῦ Θεοῦ. Ἡ προέλευσις τοῦ ὀνόματος ἀπὸ τῆς ἑβραϊκῆς γλώττῆς, ὅπου ἡ λέξις אדון (Adon) δηλοῖ τὸν Κύριον ἤ τὸν Δεσπότην.

in_latin.name: Adon
in_latin.meaning: Adon significat Dominus vel Dominium in lingua Latina
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Adon in lingua Latina, quod significat Dominus vel Dominium, est appellatio divina quae exprimit potestatem et dominationem Dei. Etymologia nominis Adon a lingua hebraea derivatur, in qua vox אדון (Adon) designat Dominum seu Dominatorem. In traditione christiana, nomen Adon refertur ad potestatem et auctoritatem divinam.

in_english.name: Adon
in_english.meaning: Lord, Master, or Ruler in English
in_english.long_meaning: The name Adon originates from the Hebrew word אדון (Adon), meaning Lord, Master, or Ruler. It is a title used in the Bible to refer to God, emphasizing His sovereignty and dominion over all creation. In Christian tradition, Adon signifies the power and authority of God, reflecting His role as the supreme ruler and controller of history. The name conveys a sense of strength, leadership, and divine guidance.

data.spiritual_significance: For Christians, the name Adon carries deep spiritual significance as it embodies the idea of God as a loving and generous master, who cares for His people and seeks to guide and protect them. This name serves as a reminder of the covenant relationship between God and His people, as well as the ultimate sacrifice and redemption made possible through Jesus Christ. Using the name Adon in prayer and worship can help deepen one's connection with God and foster a sense of devotion and reverence.
